annotations.title: Check a South African ID, tax, VAT or company number

description: Format and check-digit checks for South African numbers: ID number (Luhn check digit, date of birth, gender, citizenship), income tax reference, VAT number (10 digits starting with 4), PAYE/SDL/UIF employer references and CIPC company registration numbers. Offline checks only — they do not confirm the number is registered.
